profileBio:
Life's too short to blend in, wear crazy clothes!
✨for orders +961 71 358 363
✨exchange available within 2 days
✨worldwide shipping
about: Lisa Style is a Lebanese fashion page sharing relaxed coordinated looks, zip-front tops, shorts and printed T-shirt styles. The public bio lists an international Lebanese order number, worldwide shipping and exchange availability within two days. Orders and final item details are confirmed directly with the shop.

products.name: Zip Lounge Set
products.description: Zip-front top and matching relaxed trousers are grouped in one edit across pink/navy, cream/brown and grey/black colour presentations. Confirm current price and availability with Lisa Style. Ask the shop to confirm the pictured pieces, brand details, materials, measurements and sizing. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

products.name: Monochrome T-Shirt Edit
products.description: Three distinct black-and-white T-shirt designs shown in Lisa Style’s public November carousel are grouped as one printed-top edit. Specify the pictured design when enquiring. Confirm current price and availability with Lisa Style. Ask the shop to confirm the pictured pieces, brand details, materials, measurements and sizing. Styling accessories are not automatically included.

activityEvidence.observation: Root verified rendered public carousel timestamp 2026-11-15T18:17:53.000Z and caption Whatsapp71358363. The carousel contains video players and exposes still poster images; no videos were downloaded.
Root traversed three normal-photo carousel slides. Full-resolution served photo sources downloaded natively1320x1562.

restrictions: 10 selected unique images:3truephoto-carouselstills at1320x1562,3publiccarouselposter/covers at480x640,4publicReelcovers at361x640. No source was upscaled and no video frames were extracted.
Two pairs of Reel covers reuse the same underlying photo with different text overlays:cover1/4 andcover2/6. Onlycover4 andcover6selected. Byte-identical carousel repeats were also removed.
An ambiguous garment held by a model incover3was excluded. Three text-only pinned posts and all profile/highlight pictures were excluded.

Some posted photographs include baked-in prices from October2026. These are historical image text, not verified current selling prices. Catalogue prices are null; visible product descriptions instruct customers to confirm current price and availability.

T-shirt/poster photographs and one top cover contain third-party brand logos. Product labels do not claim genuine branded authenticity, authorized retail status or official brand affiliation. Brand details require owner confirmation.

One excluded duplicate topcover2contains an unrelated @friki_shop watermark. The underlying photo is also present inselectedcover6onLisaStyle’s public page; original photo ownership is unverified and must be reviewed by the owner before finalcommerciallaunch.
Root did not observe AI-content labels on the reviewed posts. Underlying photographic authenticity has not been independently established.
No precise physical branch, trading hours, delivery charges, payment methods or full exchange conditions were verified. Do not invent them.
Only six grouped garment edits were created; alternate colours and repeated source imagery are not padded into separate products.
